---
title: "Publication Policy"
---

## Evidence and reproducibility

Published articles distinguish **source-reported model characteristics**, **experimental observations**, and **interpretations or hypotheses**. Results should be interpreted in the context of the stated cohort, scoring configuration, and evaluation protocol.

Charts visualize reported aggregate metrics. Methodology, evidence boundaries, and uncertainty are described alongside the corresponding findings.

## Research artifacts, source code, and rights

Additional research artifacts, source code, or checkpoints may be linked per publication when relevant and cleared for release. Website publication does not imply an open-source license.

Publication does not imply authorization to reuse third-party materials or that the research represents an employer or institution.

## Corrections

Factual corrections and technical questions can be raised via GitHub Issues. Any future GitHub Discussions space, if enabled, is intended for technical discussion rather than an open research lab.
